text:
sarah: Quick chase for INC-512 postmortem remediations — several items are past their deadline. Owners: @tom (TP-33), @priya (PR-22), @ken (KV-09). Please post a one-line status and any blockers.

sarah: Copied action items: 
```
- TP-33: router connection pool safety (owner: tom) — target 2026-03-08
- PR-22: autoscale cooldown tuning + docs (owner: priya) — target 2026-03-09
- KV-09: KV cache eviction tracing and alert (owner: ken) — target 2026-03-11
```

oncall-bot: AUTO: INC-512 remediation overdue notice sent to owners: tom, priya, ken.

tom: TP-33 status: implemented change locally, working through regression on e2e. ETA end of day tomorrow. PR soon: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/pull/210

priya: PR-22 status: made the tuning change but need docs review from platform team — filed DOCS-97. Will post final commit after doc signoff.

ken: KV-09 status: alert rule is written, but traces are noisy in prod; adding sampling + higher fidelity traces in staging to validate. Deploying staging now.

sarah: Thanks. If anyone needs >24h because of external dependency, call it out so we can reassign or escalate. We've had several remediations drift with external blockers lately.

lei: If there’s an external blocker, escalate to me and I’ll convene a quick sync with platform infra. We don’t want these sitting.

priya: Docs review is blocking for PR-22 — DOCS-97 assigned to @platform-docs. I pinged them in #docs. If they can’t review today, request reassign.

tom: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/pull/210 (1778003000). CI flaky on e2e, rerunning now.

oncall-bot: Reminder: CI rerun for PR 210 started by tom.

ken: Staging traces look good now, alert rule in place. Commit: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/commit/aa77c3f. Deploying to prod tomorrow AM.

priya: Docs team acknowledged, review queued. If not approved by EOD I'll drop a shorter doc and link it here to unblock the remediation.

sarah: Good plan. Two process asks: 1) paste final commit/PR links here when merged/deployed, 2) update the postmortem tracker doc with final status or ownership handoff.

tom: PR merged 1778004200 — commit cb9f1d4, adds connection pool guardrails + regression test: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/commit/cb9f1d4

priya: docs signed off and PR merged: https://git.internal/r/redwood/platform/commit/1e2d3f4 (1778004300) — updated cooldown section and added ops playbook.

ken: Prod deploy completed for KV-09 at 1778004600. Commit/alert: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/commit/aa77c3f (same as staging) — alert now includes sampled traces.

sarah: Verified commits/links for TP-33, PR-22, KV-09. Updating tracker and marking INC-512 remediations as closed-to-verified. If anything regresses reopen INC-512 or file a follow-up INF ticket and ping #incidents. Thanks. :white_check_mark:

lei: Noted. Will audit for recurring patterns next week (multiple cache and autoscale items showing up). Might create a recurring remediation retrospective to catch systemic issues.

oncall-bot: NOTE: INC-512 remediation status changed to "overdue" -> "verified" by sarah (1778004834).

sarah: Appreciate the quick fixes. If anyone wants a hand reducing recurrence, raise a quick sync and Ill add it to next weeks reliability agenda.
